source.title: Data-Driven Intelligent Analysis System for Monitoring and Anomaly Detection in Hydrogen Refueling Station

observed_evidence.facility: BAM demonstration hydrogen refueling station, Germany
observed_evidence.data_availability_statement: Original contributions are included in the article; further inquiries are directed to the authors.

eligibility_decision.reason: The public article provides field-validation description and figures, but no downloadable synchronized station-to-vehicle raw logger archive, channel dictionary, calibration uncertainty package or explicit raw-data reuse terms.
allowed_use: data-request lead for a de-identified event-level export
architecture comparison for HRS safety monitoring
prohibited_use: parameter tuning of the locked production model

next_action: Request de-identified event-level pressure, temperature, mass-flow, controller/protocol, receptacle and calibration metadata from the authors through an approved institutional channel; freeze model and scoring before any numerical outcomes are accessed.
claim_boundary: This record strengthens source accounting only. It is not raw validation evidence and does not change the IJHE or full-objective completion gates.
